shapeSummary: Single-piece clevis bracket: 40x8x32 mm base plate with two 10 mm thick, 30 mm tall parallel ears (20 mm slot between them), a 10 mm cross pin along X through both ears near the top, and two 6.5 mm vertical through holes in the base between the ears.
warnings: Only the 10 mm pin diameter is given; all other dimensions are estimates scaled from the photos.
Y is up, with the bottom at Y=0. The analysis JSON used Z as up, so its axes were remapped.
The analysis positions put the pin and a base hole at the same length coordinate. I moved the pin toward one end (Z=-6) and the base holes to Z=2 and 12.
The pin is modeled as a solid 10 mm cylinder fused to the ears, with no separate hole or clearance. The cotter clip, bolts and nuts are omitted.
The ear tops are left square because the rounding is uncertain.
Base hole diameter and spacing are visual estimates.
cadquery:
base = cq.Workplane('XY').box(40, 8, 32, centered=(True, False, True))
ear_l = cq.Workplane('XY').box(10, 30, 32, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((-15, 0, 0))
ear_r = cq.Workplane('XY').box(10, 30, 32, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((15, 0, 0))
body = base.union(ear_l).union(ear_r)
holes = cq.Workplane('XZ').pushPoints([(0, 2), (0, 12)]).circle(3.25).extrude(-10)
body = body.cut(holes)
pin = cq.Workplane('YZ').workplane(offset=-22).center(21, -6).circle(5).extrude(44)
part = body.union(pin)
